summary: Erroneous reserve-credit offset after mixed quantized hosted + dedicated usage
description:
Issue summary: BrightVoice Labs reports an apparent negative-line offset on their March 2 invoice where reserved capacity credits from Dedicated usage appear to have been offset by hosted quantized model consumption, resulting in a net negative charge line for reserve credits. Impact: customer-facing finance and accounting team is unable to reconcile month-to-date spend; they paused automated invoice reconciliation and requested audit. Environment: prod-us-west (primary), some batch runs in eu-west. Business impact: accounting hold, delayed month-end close, potential provisioning freeze if unresolved.

Observed behavior:
- On 2026-03-02 02:00-05:00 UTC, BrightVoice consumed dedicated reserved hours and concurrently sent bursts to hosted endpoints using the quantized variant of gpt-j-7b.
- The billing job that runs hourly produced a negative-line offset on invoice line item "Reserved Capacity Adjustment" totaling -$12,430.00 on the customer's billing ledger.
- Finance UI shows the reserve-credit as applied and then a second adjustment that nullified the reserved-credit without a matching reversal event.

Expected behavior:
- Reserved capacity credits should be applied against dedicated-hour usage only. Hosted usage (even if it uses quantized variants) should be billed separately and should not trigger negative reserve-credit offsets.

Steps requested from support:
1) Audit the ledger entries and provide a timeline of the adjustments.
2) Identify whether the hourly metering aggregation job double-applied reconciliations when mixed queues (dedicated + hosted quantized) were present.
3) Provide a provisional credit or hold adjustments until ledger is corrected.
4) Root cause and mitigation plan to prevent recurrence.
steps_to_reproduce: Customer runs scheduled reserved capacity jobs on Dedicated pool (us-west) during 02:00-05:00 UTC.
Simultaneously, client sends burst traffic to hosted API using quantized gpt-j-7b model in us-west region.
Billing metering job aggregates hourly usage and applies reserved credits and hosted usage charges.
Observe ledger entries where reserved-credit line is applied and subsequently neutralized by an adjustment without corresponding invoice reversal event.

comments: 2026-03-13 - Maya Chen (Support): I reached out to BrightVoice finance and collected invoice screenshots and CSV export. They confirmed they did not manually trigger any credits or refunds.

2026-03-13 - Liam O'Connor (Billing Eng): Initial hypothesis: hourly reconciliation job may have attempted a post-hoc smoothing pass that conflated reserved-hour entitlements with hosted quantized consumption when queues were co-located. Will review reconciliation logs and idempotency keys.
2026-03-13 - BrightVoice (Customer): We see a negative reserve line; this is blocking our month-end close. Please escalate to finance and ops.
investigation_notes: Checked reconciliation job logs for 2026-03-02 window: found two reconcile attempts for org brightvoice within same hour: attempt_id a1f3 and retry a1f3-retry01; second attempt had an empty adjustment_ref field and produced a reversal entry.

Metering-service emitted identical idempotency_key for dedicated and hosted aggregate events when queue names included the same org prefix and 'quant' suffix — possible key-collision bug introduced in quantized-metering refactor (deploy 2026-02-28).
We reproduced locally by simulating co-located queue names: re-run caused double-adjust application if reconcile retry executed without persisted adjustment_ref.
temporary_mitigation: Suspended automatic reserve-credit reconciliation for BrightVoice Labs (org id: org_brightvoice) and set billing pipeline to manual-review for any adjustments generated between 2026-02-28 and 2026-03-04.
next_steps: 1) Engineering to patch metering idempotency key generation to include queue-type and unique request id (owner: Liam). 2) Finance to schedule manual ledger correction and issue provisional credit until reconciliation finishes (owner: Priya from Finance). 3) Run backfill reconciliation job with idempotency-safe checks; target completion 2026-03-16.
resolution: Workaround applied: temporarily suspended automatic reserve-credit reconciliation for org_brightvoice and placed the disputed adjustments into a manual review queue. Finance opened ticket FIN-4879 to apply a ledger correction. Engineering has a patch PR; scheduled backfill and validation. Final ledger correction planned by 2026-03-16.
